messages:
Maya P: Heads-up — bringing up new 7B-quant-v2 for onboarding eval next week. Need to align on prompt cohorts, holdouts, and labeler capacity. Who can sync today?
Sanjay R: I can. Quick Q: do we want stratified cohorts by intent or by failure mode?
Maya P: Mix of both. Primary split: intent buckets (QA, summarization, extraction, instruction-following) and orthogonal failure buckets (long-context, numeric, paraphrase, multi-turn).
Alex T: Recommend reserving a ~100-example adversarial holdout (senior labelers only) for regression gating. Keep it out of main pool entirely.
Lia Chen: I will run fingerprint dedupe before ingest. Please ensure each record has source_id + created_at. Also need ctx_len and language tags for routing.
Maya P: Agreed. Tag schema: cohort:<intent|failure> ; source_id; ctx_len; lang. Also include approx_token_count.
Sanjay R: Batch sizing: target 1,000 eval items total, broken into 5 rounds of ~200. Each item gets 3 independent labels. That keeps turnaround and variance checks manageable.
Alex T: For quant experiments we need per-item metadata: model_variant, quant_setting, seed_prompt_version. Add that to dataset manifest.
Lia Chen: Drafting the labeling playbook now — label schema v2: answer_correct (yes/no), hallucination_flag (y/n), utility_score (1-5), short rationale (1-2 sentences). Will include examples and borderline rules.
Maya P: Nice. Add a short checklist for labelers: do not consult model logs, one-answer principle, mark ambiguous as ambiguous not correct.
Sanjay R: How do we handle near-duplicates across cohorts? If dedupe score >0.85 drop from main pool, but allow if it's a targeted stress item.
Lia Chen: I'll output a dedupe report with hashes and similarity scores. Command I ran:
```bash
python tools/dedupe.py --input new_batch.ndjson --threshold 0.85 --out dedupe-report.csv
```
Maya P: Perfect. Where does the playbook live?
Lia Chen: I'll open a PR to datasets/prompt-onboard/playbooks and paste the starter examples. Link in thread when ready.
label-sync-bot: new batch created 2167778899 — 200 items queued (cohorts: QA-40, Summ-40, Extract-40, Instr-40, Stress-40). Assigned to label-queue-2.
Sanjay R: For adjudication, if 2/3 agree take majority; if 1/3 disagree escalate to the senior annotator queue within 48h.
Alex T: Add metric hooks: per-cohort PASSED_RATE, HALLUCINATION_RATE, MEAN_UTILITY. We'll compare 7B-quant-v2 vs baseline 7B-raw and record per-token latency too.
Maya P: Also add an experimental column for quantitization-bit (e.g., 8bit,4bit) and kernel flags. We want to link regressions to specific quant settings.
Lia Chen: Upload plan + playbook by EOD. I'll add 12 seed examples per cohort and 25 edgecases for the adversarial holdout.
Maya P: Great. Follow-ups: (1) Sanjay to map cohorts -> label batches by EOD tomorrow, (2) Lia to PR playbook + dedupe report, (3) Alex to add eval metrics dashboard template.
Sanjay R: On it. Will allocate 6 labelers to queue-2 and reserve 2 senior adjudicators.
Maya P: Thanks. Ping here when PR and batch mappings are ready. :thumbsup: 
Lia Chen: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/datasets/pull/482 — includes playbook v0.1 and seed examples.
Maya P: Reviewing now. Small nit: add one more numeric example under 'extraction' for rounding edgecase.
Lia Chen: Added, PR updated.
label-sync-bot: batch 2167778899 status -> in-progress (120/200 labelled).
Alex T: I'll spin the initial eval runs tomorrow morning and post preliminary diffs.
Maya P: Awesome — thanks everyone.
